title: Through the Red Door, a Hundred-Second Countdown Began | ECHO//30 Ep. 5
description:
Kavi finds his father's final cassette beyond the Red Door—but the Door demands an equal exchange. The moment he takes it, one precious memory disappears forever.

Tara refuses to let Kavi call that sacrifice protection. Then the cassette begins playing, and Arvind's warning reveals that every lock around the forgotten platform has failed.
